title: feat(objectql)!: email template names held per namespace, a send resolves its template from its package, and ?package= reads an email template exactly (ADR-0150 child B, webhook family 1/3)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBHWCuY8Wd44TH1DXMgFmsUZ)_

Part of #31699
Supersedes #32089

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：两个不同命名空间的包现在可以各自带同名邮件模板；发送按发起它的包解析模板名（ADR-0150 D3），流程的 notify 节点传入流程自己被启用的包；不带包的发送保持原义（环境项 → 唯一持有者 → 409 列出全部持有者）；`?package=` 精确读取邮件模板；配对包里一条可能属于两个包的 Studio 新增语言行在两个精确地址都返回 409，`os migrate stored-references` 列出它。
- 为什么改：ADR-0150 child B 的邮件模板部分；#32089 的合同复审 FAIL（F1：开关打开后两持有者的名字每次发送都被拒；F2：一条配对行同时被两个包当作自己的），史诗席位裁定两项都按根因修复。
- 风险与回滚：收窄三处（都已声明，第一方调用方 0）：`?package=X` 读 X 不持有的名字、阶段 1 前已封存的同名冲突的裸读、打包流程的 notify 模板在其依赖闭包之外；其余只放宽。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/template-loader.ts`（`bundleAddressOf`）、`packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/notify-node.ts`、`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-exact-qualifier.ts`（`pairMemberOwners`）、`packages/cli/src/utils/stored-package-references.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-email exec vitest run src/template-loader.test.ts src/send-template.test.ts`，以及 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts`，应全绿，其中 "[#31699 F1]" 与 "[#31699 F2]" 两节逐级钉住。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — three refusals where a template was served before. (1) `GET /meta/email_template/NAME?package=X` (and `getMetaItem` with a `packageId`) for a name package X does not hold is refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` (`not-held-by-qualifier`, naming every holder), where it served the first registered package's template; first-party callers that name a package: 0. (2) The bare `GET /meta/email_template/NAME` of a name two packages already held before the one-holder rule (a clash the cold boot seals with a warning) is refused `409` naming both, where it served the first registered one (ADR-0150, covered types). (3) A flow's `notify` node now sends its template as the flow's own package (`SendTemplateInput.callerPackageId`): from a package whose own flow body is armed, a template name no holder in that package's declared dependency closure holds (another package's template outside it, or a template only the environment authored) is refused `409` naming the holders, where the send served the one holder; first-party packaged flows that send a template: 0. Widened beside it: the engine's package door (`SchemaRegistry.installPackage`), its item seam (`SchemaRegistry.registerItem`) and the cold boot's holder seal (`SchemaRegistry.sealBareNameHolders`) accept, for an email template, a second package holder they refused before: one that declares a namespace other than the holder's.
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — no published skill teaches the scope of an email template name or the send's package; `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md`'s customization paragraph (a pair's added locale served on the base's address, a dependent's only under its own `?package=`) stays true for every one-holder name and is pinned by the #28802 dogfood, which stays green.

**Narrowing: yes** — first-party callers: **0** (measured). (1) No in-tree caller reads an email template with a package that does not hold it (Studio's bundle editor reads at the package its list names the item under). (2) No first-party package pair clashes on an email template name. (3) No first-party packaged flow's `notify` node names a `template:`: of the files under `examples/` and `packages/` (tests, dist and the engine itself excluded) that carry a `type: 'notify'` node, none carries a string `template:` key (the `notify` nodes of `app-showcase` and `app-todo` send inline `title` / `message`). The full dogfood battery ran on the final head (Verification).

This is the first of three PRs for #31699 (seat ruling Q1 = A): email_template here, then webhook, then connector (`Fixes #31699`). Only `email_template` joins `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES` here.

## Patch round

This round answers the contract review record [6761777785](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/32089#issuecomment-6761777785) (VERDICT FAIL) under the epic seat's rulings [6761802819](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/32089#issuecomment-6761802819), from `claude/project-thread-x11fa6@a52f89e0` merged with `origin/main`.

| Item | Change | Pin |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **F1** (must-fix, epic: root fix) — the send resolved caller-less, so every send of a two-holder name would have been refused | `SendTemplateInput` / `RenderTemplateInput.callerPackageId` (spec); `EmailService.resolveAndRenderTemplate` hands it to every `TemplateLoader.load` rung and `bundleLocales`; the registry loader resolves D3 from it (`bundleAddressOf`) and, for a name two packages hold, reads only the resolved holder's address (`getMetaItemsForExecution({ type, packageId })`). The `notify` node records `AutomationEngine.flowCallerPackage(context)` (the flow's armed package, never the definition's `_packageId` stamp) as `templateCallerPackageId`; the email and inbox channels forward it. A literal payload key of that name is dropped. | plugin-email `template-loader.test.ts` "[#31699 F1]": own holder per namespace (alpha, beta), closure holder, outside-closure 409, **no package: two holders → 409** (undefined and null), one holder → served, environment item → served, dependent addition reads its base, registry-only narrowing. `send-template.test.ts`: the caller reaches every rung (control: omitted / null / empty → none). `notify-node.test.ts`: armed package named, env body stamped `_packageId` names none, literal key dropped, inline path names none. `email-channel.test.ts`, `inbox-channel.test.ts`: forwarded (control: absent). Dogfood `bare-name-one-holder-flow-family`: `renderTemplate` as alpha → alpha's subject, as beta → beta's. |
| **F2** (should-fix, epic: refuse both when two pairs could own the row) | `exactQualifierItem` keeps a pair row on a base only when the row has one owner among the name's holders (`pairMemberOwners`), else `409 ambiguous-in-closure` naming every owner; the App's own address keeps ruling A; a row declaring `overrides.package` is served at that base only. The package-scoped list (#28802 block) leaves such a row out (`pairMemberWithheldAt`). `os migrate stored-references` lists it under `pairMembers` with its candidates. | objectql `package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts` "[#31699 F2]": two holders → 409 on both exact reads naming both, both lists omit it; one holder → served (#28390 A); the App's own address → served; after a bind (`overrides.package: X`) → served at X only. CLI `stored-package-references.literal-namespace.test.ts`: listed with candidates `suitex/welcome`, `suitey/welcome` (control: one holder or a declared row → not listed). |
| **Legacy package-less row under two holders** (epic: declare, no card) | Declared in the changeset and below; recorded on #31527 by the epic seat. No code. | — |
| **N1** — Clause-② did not name the pre-phase-1 bare 409 | Clause-② line (2) names it, in the changeset and here. | `check-adr-0087-registration` ✓ |
| **N2** — `bare-name-one-holder.ts` said the send "reads the resolved holder's bundle only" | Now true in code (F1 reads the resolved holder's address), and the sentence says what the loader does. | the F1 narrowing pins |
| **N3** — the dev report's `dogfood_battery` line contradicted the `!` and the arm | The full battery ran on the final head; the report states its numbers. | Verification |

Declared, not changed: a legacy package-less environment row of a name two packages now hold stands in for both holders' slot, so both exact addresses serve it, as `main` already does for the nine presentation and AI types (E8). A package-less row is the customization of one holder (D4) and cannot say which; per the epic ruling it is an open item on #31527, to be refused for every covered type before that type narrows.

## What changes

- **The switch.** `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES` gains `'email_template'` (now `agent`, `skill`, `email_template`); `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES` gains it after `'api'`.
- **Platform-requested names.** Core's `PLATFORM_REQUESTED_BARE_NAMES_BY_TYPE` gains the eight `auth.*` mails; they resolve environment-wide whatever the caller and keep one overriding package per deployment.
- **Bundle addition.** A package that ships only locales its base does not ship is still judged against the base whatever the namespaces (`isBundleAdditionPair`); a send made from it resolves from its closure.
- **The send (F1).** `callerPackageId` on the send contract, through `EmailService`, `TemplateLoader` (`TemplateLoadOptions`, exported) and the registry loader, which narrows to the resolved holder's address only when two or more packages hold the name, so every one-holder name reads byte-identically to before. The `notify` node, `templateCallerPackageOf` in service-messaging, and both channels.
- **Exact qualifier (F2).** `pairMemberOwners` / `pairMemberWithheldAt` in metadata-protocol; `pairMemberOwners` exported for the CLI.
- **Upgrade report.** `collectStoredPackageReferences` adds `pairMembers` (a keyset walk of active `sys_metadata` rows of package-read types stored under a customization package with two or more owners); `os migrate stored-references` prints them with the `overrides.package` hint and counts them in its total.
- **Unchanged.** The refusal's envelope, code and sentence; every type outside the set; the webhook and connector readers (PRs 2 and 3).

## Tests

All on head `1484ab59`, after a full `pnpm build`.

- Package suites, each also `typecheck` exit 0 (and `check:test-typecheck` exit 0 where the package has it): plugin-email **845/845**, service-automation **3565/3565**, service-messaging **878/878**, metadata-protocol **22665 passed (29 skipped)**, core **3271/3271**, objectql **12074/12074**, cli **7809 passed (10 skipped)**, spec **26502 passed (1 todo)**.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` exit 0; `check:api-surface` exit 0.
- `pnpm lint` exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: every one of the **101** commands run with its exit recorded; `--ran` → **101 derived, 101 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN**, every exit 0.
- Dogfood over the rebuilt dist: `bare-name-one-holder-flow-family`, `bare-name-one-holder-ai-family` and every `email-template-*` file (boot-sweep, dependent-unshipped-locale-read, materialization, overlay-survives-boot, override-unshipped-locale, two-locales-survive-boot): **8 files, 47/47**.
- Full dogfood battery on this head: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` exit 0: **446 files passed (3 skipped), 3709 tests passed (42 skipped)**, 1784 s.

## Acceptance notes

- Ablations, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (mutation landed, restored to the HEAD blob with an empty `git diff HEAD`); the metadata-protocol legs over a rebuilt dist with `ablation-dist-preflight` finding the marker, then `--absent` after the restore build:
  - A1 loader narrowing off (`holders.length < 2 || true`): 3 red (each namespace's send reads its own address, a dependent's addition reads its base's address, registry-only narrowing).
  - A4 `EmailService` drops the caller (`loadOptions` → none): 1 red (the caller reaches every rung).
  - A2 `notify` records no caller: 1 red (armed package named).
  - A8 the literal payload key is kept: 1 red (literal key dropped).
  - A3 email channel does not forward: 1 red. A3b inbox channel does not forward: 1 red.
  - A7 CLI lists only at 99 owners: 1 red (the two-holder row listed).
  - A5 exact qualifier refuses only at 99 owners (dist): 1 red (two holders → 409 on both).
  - A6 the list keeps the row (dist): 2 red (two holders' lists omit it; after a bind only X serves).
- Changed lines: 33 files, +1565 / −108 against `origin/main` (under 3000).
- The seat closes #32089.
